name: Avatar
structurePatterns: circular container; fallback priority: image -> initials -> generic identity icon (Lucide user)
initials use stable low-saturation tinted backgrounds and brand text
optional status indicator (small dot) overlays bottom-right with a 2px surface ring
image fills the circle with object-fit cover
usageHints: do not encode all status into the avatar itself
meaningful images require accessible name or adjacent text
larger profile imagery belongs to patterns, not the base avatar
doNotInvent: no status color ring by default
unknowns: image source is placeholder in previews
